mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_org WHERE id = #{orgId} UNION ALL SELECT o.id FROM sys_org o INNER JOIN org_tree t ON o.parent_id = t.id ) SELECT id FROM org_tree
SELECT * FROM sys_org WHERE parent_id = '0' AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order

WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS ( SELECT id, org_name, parent_id, org_level, org_type, org_code, 1 as depth FROM sys_org WHERE id = #{orgId} AND status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.org_name, o.parent_id, o.org_level, o.org_type, o.org_code, t.depth + 1 FROM sys_org o INNER JOIN org_tree t ON o.parent_id = t.id WHERE o.status = 1 ) SELECT * FROM org_tree
SELECT * FROM sys_org WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
